description: Recorded fake outreach cycle that meets a LinkedIn security check: after the stop hint the agent writes stop.json, runs detect, closes its tab and ends the cycle. Nothing else. Browser calls are recorded in the shapes the jobhunter-guard plugin accepts: act kinds with refs from the latest snapshot of the same tab, upload with paths and a ref, drivers as act kind evaluate whose fn is the exact driver file text ({DRIVER:<name>} stands for the text of drivers/<name>.js).

detect_file.title: Security Verification | LinkedIn
detect_file.text: Let's do a quick security check
